goal:
Solve index calculus for ECDLP over prime fields, iteratively: each round should move the measured index-calculus baseline toward matched Pollard rho, under the success criterion of isogeny-labs/crypto AGENTS.md ("every verified, measured improvement over the current index-calculus baseline is a success; relabelling and accounting changes are not improvements").

This is the first live run of the program loop, and its tools are limited: atlas-match (which leads and known results an idea collides with), card-lint (whether a committed task card lints), and no compute. A useful round therefore picks one open lead from the context, checks it with atlas-match, and states the single cheapest discriminating measurement that a later round with compute tools would run, with its falsification criterion. Do not claim a measurement that no tool run recorded.

proposal.claim: The open_blocked lead LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid (full-width complete-solve IC arity grid at 50–63-bit subgroups with prime coset/small-x bases) has a recorded blocking reason and a decided next_action that can be advanced without new compute, enabling a concrete measurement plan.
proposal.prediction: Running atlas-match on LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid will return a non-empty lead record containing a blocking_reason field and a next_action field that names a specific, tool-verifiable step (e.g., 'measure m=3 summation-polynomial relation yield at 50-bit with fixed factor-base size') rather than a generic research direction.
proposal.test: Run `python3 tools/lead_atlas.py --match "LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid"` and verify the output contains a lead object with id LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid, status open_blocked, and non-null blocking_reason and next_action fields.
proposal.falsification: If atlas-match returns an empty array, or the matched lead has status closed_obstructed/known_result/dominated, or blocking_reason/next_action are missing or null, the claim is refuted for this round.
proposal.goal: Execute atlas-match on LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid to retrieve its blocking_reason and next_action; then lint a task card (card-lint) that specifies the single cheapest discriminating measurement named in next_action (e.g., a single 50-bit subgroup, m=3 summation-polynomial relation harvest with fixed factor-base, wall-clock timed against a negation-map Pollard-rho baseline on identical parameters), including the exact falsification criterion (measured IC exponent ≥ 0.5 or relation yield < linear-algebra threshold).

claims.text: atlas-match returns a non-empty lead record for LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid with status open_blocked and non-null blocking_reason and next_action naming a tool-verifiable measurement step
claims.reason: action 1 is not a verifier tool

review.learned: atlas-match returned an empty array for LEAD-ICP-full-width-arity-grid, indicating the lead ID is not present in the atlas (or not in open_blocked status). The claim that it has a recorded blocking_reason and decidable next_action is false.
review.feedback: Select a different open lead from the context that exists in the atlas, then run atlas-match on it to obtain a concrete blocking_reason and tool-verifiable next_action.
